Coordinating conjunctions and / but / or: Coordinating conjunctions connect two parallel parts; choose by the logical relation.本课为易错辨析练习,核心:and = parallel, but = contrast, or = choice/otherwise, so = result。

and connects parallel words or sentences|but expresses contrast|or expresses choice, or 'otherwise' in imperative sentences|so expresses result|In negative parallel sentences use or: I don't like apples or bananas
